## About
Prime Pros Remodeling Contractor is a residential contractor serving the Houston area from Cypress. We handle general home renovation, roofing repair, new windows and a lot in between, with careful attention to detail on every project.
We work out the design, construction methods and budget with you, then keep you posted every step of the way. Designs, material selection, budgeting, permitting and scheduling are tracked so the whole process is easier to trust.
Our neighbors seem to agree. We hold a 5 rating from 53 Google reviews, and reviewers bring up Enrique, the crew, and how the house was left clean at the end of each day.

## Services
- Kitchen and bath Design and remodeling: Kitchen and bathroom design and remodeling, planned with you from the start.
- Home Additions: That extra bedroom or study you've been wanting.
- Outdoor Kitchens: An outdoor kitchen for your backyard.
- Roofing: Roofing work, along with flooring, paint and general contracting.
- Siding Installation: We help you pick the right siding product for your home.
- Concrete Services: Driveways, foundations, sidewalks and more.
- Flooring and paint: New floors and fresh paint, whether it's one room or the whole house.

## FAQ
Q: Can we stay in our home during the remodel?
A: Yes. One family stayed in their home for the whole project.

Q: Do you handle permits?
A: Yes. Permitting is part of what we track for you, along with design, materials, budgeting and scheduling.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: We're based in Cypress and serve the Houston area.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Give us a call at (281) 912-9446, email info@primeprosremodel.com, or send the contact form and our staff will get back to you promptly.
